scope: Independent typed subtitle settings, track discovery and rendered pixels for two Video channels with different files and a shared playback clock.

native.build: Isolated bundled UI build with pinned FFmpeg DLLs on PATH and Tauri resource copying disabled for this build
native.fix: Live-route pruning retains the caption texture referenced by the Video composite.
alsoVerified: Separate embedded track catalogs, even when both FFmpeg stream indexes are 1
Held cue boundaries before and after seek in a cropped range
Missing local SRT clears the captions and recovers while paused
Size, font and position inputs and generic Inspector enable/disable
Normal app shutdown and independent observer retirement

feedbackRecheck.verified: In the same Media, the second channel used its own embedded track while the first used a local SRT. Editing the second kept the first channel's output identical. Using the Inspector to disable the first kept the second channel's output identical.

inspectorRecheck.verified: The second Video channel's Inspector Track menu offered its own embedded stream and excluded the first channel's stream. Choosing the track rendered the second caption and preserved the first channel's local SRT output pixel for pixel. Disabling the first channel in the Inspector preserved the second channel's caption pixel for pixel.

pending: Moving native Media Preview and output at multiple speeds, including reverse and hard/smooth loop boundaries on full and cropped ranges
Broader native consumer, mixed-duration and file replacement coverage during playback
Retained Video integration, recovery, resource and both-GPU qualification
